hints.L0: Think about how two's complement subtraction (a - b) can be done by inverting b and adding 1.
hints.L3: Replicate sub to 32 bits and XOR with b to get b_xor. Split a and b_xor into low 16 bits (15:0) and high 16 bits (31:16). Instantiate the first add16 with a[15:0], b_xor[15:0], cin=sub. Connect its cout to the cin of the second add16 which takes a[31:16] and b_xor[31:16]. Concatenate the two sums (high then low) to form the 32-bit sum.

common_mistakes: Forgetting to replicate sub to 32 bits before XOR, causing only the LSB of b to be inverted.
Using sub as carry-in for the high adder instead of the low adder's carry-out.
Swapping the order of concatenation (putting low sum in high bits).
Not connecting the carry chain between the two add16 instances.
top: module top_module(input [31:0] a, input [31:0] b, input sub, output [31:0] sum)
review_notes: Spec: removed the XOR-with-replicated-sub and carry-in wiring; kept the two's complement idea. The wiring stays in L3.
